data.one_liner: Removes backgrounds from images offline using an ONNX machine learning model.
data.what_it_does: Processes image byte data locally using an on-device ONNX machine learning model to remove backgrounds without relying on any external APIs. It also provides options for adjusting thresholds, edge enhancement, and adding custom background colors.
use_when: You need to remove image backgrounds completely offline on-device.
You want privacy and reliability without cloud-based API costs.
avoid_when: You are operating within Dart isolates, as the package requires main thread assets.
You want to minimize app bundle size, as the embedded model adds around 30MB.
strengths: Works entirely offline without external API dependencies.
Provides customizable edge enhancement and background color composition.
weaknesses: Increases the application bundle size by approximately 30MB due to the bundled offline model.
Cannot be used inside Dart isolates.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring iOS Podfile for minimum iOS 16.0 and modifying Xcode build settings (Strip Linked Product to No) for release builds.
